definitions.explanation: A printed publication containing news, articles, and advertisements, typically published daily.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{新聞|しんぶん}を{読|よ}みます。
examples.english: I read the newspaper every morning.

examples.japanese: {新聞|しんぶん}に{何|なに}が{書|か}いてありますか。
{新聞|しんぶん}を{買|か}いました。

notes: 新聞 literally means 'new things heard.' Major Japanese newspapers include 朝日新聞 (Asahi), 読売新聞 (Yomiuri), 毎日新聞 (Mainichi). Related: 新聞社 (shinbunsha, newspaper company), 新聞記事 (shinbun kiji, newspaper article).
